field_principles.action_entropy_precheck: bare float expectation for routed action/coordinate diversity before the live attempt.
field_principles.already_reproduced: must remain false because duplicate live levels cannot satisfy the ARC standing progress floor.
field_principles.arc_clean_precheck_ready: bare bool true only when registry, no-LLM substrate, provenance, seed/checksum, live path, and suppression gates pass.
field_principles.field_principles: mapping of one-line principle annotations for every headline and gate field.
field_principles.honest_verdict: one-line verdict starting complete: or blocked: without claiming a solve.
field_principles.llm_strategy_proposer_used: bare bool false proving this precheck did not load or invoke an LLM strategy proposer.
field_principles.no_model_specs_required: bare bool true because the no-LLM substrate has no model invocation to name.
field_principles.random_seed: deterministic seed required for third-party reruns of the target choice and checksum.
field_principles.registry_precheck_passed: bare bool proving the registry was read and the selected level is not already reproduced.
field_principles.repeated_coordinate_suppression_enabled: bare bool proving repeated-coordinate suppression is active before action entropy is trusted.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed hash over registry target, seed, substrate, and routing gates to catch silent drift.
field_principles.selected_game: registry-safe game id selected for the next clean no-LLM live-path attempt.
field_principles.selected_level: adjacent unreproduced frontier level label selected after the duplicate registry precheck.
field_principles.solve_provenance: must equal live_agent_self_discovery even though this artifact claims no solve.
field_principles.strategy_routing_live_path_reachable: bare bool proving the bounded candidate router is reachable from the live candidate-router hook.
field_principles.tests_added_or_reused: list of focused tests covering duplicate blocking, no-model metadata, checksum determinism, and schema gates.

honest_verdict: complete: g50t L3 clean no-LLM ARC precheck ready; no solve claimed

strategy_portfolio.name: salience_first
strategy_portfolio.principle: try visually salient live candidates first without spending the whole budget on one coordinate.

strategy_portfolio.name: action_effect_memory
strategy_portfolio.principle: prefer candidates with observed or cached action-effect evidence.

strategy_portfolio.name: verifier_router_candidate_ranking
strategy_portfolio.principle: rank compatible candidates by verifier-style confidence with stable fallback order.

strategy_portfolio.name: conservative_reset_reinduction
strategy_portfolio.principle: reserve a small budget for reset or reinduction-safe candidates after local evidence stalls.
